description: This file implements functions and classes related to managing alternative network services, including protocol validation, histogram logging, and processing alternative service entries for protocols like HTTP/2 and QUIC within the Chromium project.

classes.name: AlternativeServiceInfo
classes.description: Represents information about an alternative network service, including protocol, host, port, expiration, and supported QUIC versions.

classes.name: AlternativeService
classes.description: Represents an alternative network service with protocol, host, and port.

methods.name: HistogramAlternateProtocolUsage
methods.description: Logs usage statistics for alternate protocol usage, differentiating between Google hosts and others.

methods.name: HistogramBrokenAlternateProtocolLocation
methods.description: Logs the location where an alternate protocol was broken.

methods.name: IsAlternateProtocolValid
methods.description: Checks if a given protocol is valid for use as an alternate protocol.

methods.name: IsProtocolEnabled
methods.description: Determines if a specific protocol is enabled based on feature flags.

methods.name: AlternativeServiceInfo::CreateHttp2AlternativeServiceInfo
methods.description: Creates an AlternativeServiceInfo object for HTTP/2.

methods.name: AlternativeServiceInfo::CreateQuicAlternativeServiceInfo
methods.description: Creates an AlternativeServiceInfo object for QUIC, with support for advertised versions and protocol filter override.
